name: Service Requests, RFCs, Device References, Ticket Relationships
foundation_dependencies: LLD-02 Customer/Contact/Local User Profile identity, lifecycle, affiliation and matching interfaces
LLD-04 owns immutable source observations/proposals/vocabulary; LLD-03 stores opaque evidence IDs and revalidates through providers without sequence-3 FK/trigger into sequence-4 private tables
LLD-06 ServiceRequestCustomerClassificationParticipant applies classification invalidation in caller UnitOfWork
LLD-12 authenticated-browser and deliberate-action proof policies
scope: canonical history-preserving SR Customer relationship and role-specific Contact reference relationships
accepted current Advanced Search SR source projection with exact LLD-04 field evidence
RFC exact identity and accepted current source/lifecycle projection
operational Device Reference identity and SR/RFC links
Working Notes with immutable creator provenance
not_owned_here: Customer Organization/Contact master identity and Contact affiliation -> LLD-02
Product Line/SLA classification/calculation and customer-change consequences -> LLD-06
Network Element/Device Reference regularization target -> LLD-08
transaction_boundaries: Source parsing/matching previews and expensive diff work occur outside writer transactions under owning LLDs.
Every standalone LLD-03 mutation uses one short LLD-01 BEGIN IMMEDIATE UnitOfWork with receipt, mutation and audit committed atomically.
LLD-04 accepted SR proposals own outer receipt/UoW and invoke LLD-03 mutation participants without nested commit.
SR Customer replacement and required LLD-06 classification invalidation are atomic; participant failure/INDETERMINATE rolls both back.
SR Contact association revalidates Contact lifecycle/affiliation, SR Customer and supporting handler observation under writer lock.
Terminal RFC source acceptance and pending cascade proposal creation/supersession are atomic but execute no downstream cascade.
Terminal-cascade execution revalidates proposal/terminal/scope/provider summaries before proof; after proof, one receipt precedes same-UoW LLD-05/09 applies with bounded summaries.
Archive operation/history and RFC archive changes are atomic; complete archive scope and operation projection fingerprints bind authority while audit/result refs stay constant-cardinality.

Hard-delete preview uses one stable ReadSnapshot. Command reruns identical local/provider predicates under writer read context, fails blocked/stale before proof, then proof/receipt/audit/delete/result proceed atomically; DB failure rolls back database effects but not proof reusability.
failure_modes: typed domain failures inherit LLD-01 transport/idempotency/stale/persistence errors
stale SR reference review tokens fail closed
ambiguous source Customer/Contact evidence leaves canonical relationships unchanged
LLD-06 participant failure rolls back SR Customer change
invalid/wrong-family source evidence cannot become accepted projection
INDETERMINATE lifecycle/delete dependencies block destructive/cascade action
invalid hard-delete proof returns RFC_HARD_DELETE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED after eligibility revalidation and before mutation
terminal source evidence alone never executes cascade
failure-injection suites cover cross-domain/transaction half-commit risks
review_evidence: Customer/Contact master ownership remains LLD-02; source evidence/proposals remain LLD-04.
Current Handler source text remains source-owned; Contact resolution creates no competing handler fact.
SR Customer changes invoke LLD-06 classification invalidation atomically.
LLD-03 source projections keep opaque provider-validated evidence refs without sequence-3 FK/trigger into LLD-04.
RFC source/lifecycle projection is separate from immutable source evidence.
Terminal source evidence may create pending cascade but never executes consequences.
Cascade execution binds provider revalidation to reviewed preview before proof and keeps arbitrary-cardinality histories provider-owned behind bounded summaries.
Direct SR-to-RFC links target governing root; subordinate cannot become parent.
Device Reference identity survives Infrastructure regularization; Working Notes remain SOMA-owned.
Archive/restore is operation-scoped and fingerprint-bound without cardinality caps.

Hard delete is only for determinate untouched local drafts; exact golden-vector eligibility, stable-read preview, writer revalidation-before-proof, no persisted proof material and fixed replay evidence are normative.
Public routes retain exact V2 contracts/auth/errors/bounds/audit vocabulary.
Formal Beta LLD Pass 1 and Pass 2 remain PASS; this repair requires a fresh whole-repository integrity certification before implementation.
design_principle: Ticket identity/history survive adoption, correction, hierarchy, terminal state, archive and regularization; irreversible evidence remains with its owner and cross-domain consequences use bounded history-preserving transaction interfaces.
